fields.title: Reader test: markup the cleanup changes
fields.content:
Markup the shared cleanup removes or changes. Each line says what should happen.

An inline style, which goes.

A <style> element, which goes, so this isn’t red.

An inline script, which goes.

A script from a site that isn’t an embed provider, which goes.

X’s embed script, which the page loads.

A <noscript>, which goes.

A comment follows, which goes.

An iframe with a size, which keeps its shape and narrows to fit:

A small iframe, which stays its own size:

An iframe with a percentage width, which is left alone:

A video that plays on its own, which gets controls instead:

Audio that plays on its own, which gets controls instead:

A cover block’s background video, as WordPress.com’s VideoPress sends it, which becomes a <video>:

Text on the cover

An embed that never loaded, which becomes a link:

A form, which the stylesheet hides:

An empty paragraph follows.

The end.
